baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبُّكَ ... فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ النَّبِيِّينَ عَلَى بَعْضٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The possessive Lord-address and first-person act of favoring place comparison inside divine governance. Repeated بَعْض keeps the distinction relational within one prophetic plurality; favor is both assigned degree and non-obligatory grant, while the split ر ب و inventory adds nurture and growth rather than a bare leaderboard.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign ownership supplies the governing frame within which prophetic differences are assigned.
Nourishment into growth makes lordly differentiation developmental as well as positional.
Comparative degree supplies the explicit relation of one prophetic station over another.
Gratuitous benefaction recasts superiority as received provision rather than self-produced status.
Part-within-whole language keeps both sides inside a shared prophetic body.
The God-reporting office identifies the common vocation within which distinct allotments operate.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely places prophets on a rank ladder.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents varied prophetic stations as relational, received allotments cultivated under one Lord.

baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge spans the upper and lower poles yet does not flatten their inhabitants. The knowing branch and two independent marking branches activate an image of comprehensive recognition that distinguishes each bearer by trace; this epistemic discrimination precedes and licenses the following differentiation.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower supplies comprehensive, non-conjectural awareness.
A distinguishing sign makes total knowledge individuating rather than merely aggregate.
The encompassing upper shelter supplies one pole of the ayah's maximal spatial scope.
The split-root image of a visible identifying mark reinforces recognition by distinctive trace.
The lower realm opposite the sky completes the all-domain scope.

changed_reading.before: The opening is a generic assertion of omniscience before an unrelated rank statement.
changed_reading.after: The opening depicts total yet individuating recognition as the epistemic ground of differentiated prophetic allotment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The general statement of prophetic differentiation resolves into a named recipient and a concrete written gift. Reporting, giving, and inscription form a transmission chain: a prophetic office is differentiated through an artifact that can carry and preserve a commission.

activation_trace.role: A consequential report supplies the transmissible content of prophetic work.
Bestowal makes the distinction a received commission rather than an inherent possession.
Writing and book-form give the bestowed commission a durable textual body.

changed_reading.before: David's Zabur is appended as a prestige example.
changed_reading.after: David's written gift demonstrates how divine differentiation becomes a concrete, transmissible prophetic commission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier rhetorical challenge contests a selection and allotted share projected onto the Lord by human speech. Against that failed attribution, the focus uses an asserted divine first-person act and names an actual gift. Prophetic differentiation is therefore policed at the level of authorization: it cannot be reverse-engineered from human prestige claims.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction supplies the focus ayah's positively authorized allocation.
Partition within a whole prevents the allocation from becoming an absolute division of kinds.
Choosing a select portion supplies the contested human account of divine allotment.
A specially reserved share sharpens the allocation pattern that the context rejects when falsely assigned.

structural_cues: 17:40 interrogates a claimed allocation by the Lord, whereas 17:55 asserts 'We favored' and supplies a concrete gift.
The same Lord-address links the rejected projection and the authorized differentiation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a contested selection claim and an asserted divine allocation; I infer that authorization, not comparison itself, separates them. A live alternative is that 17:40 rebukes only the gendered claim and does not govern every prestige judgment.

changed_reading.before: The comparison invites readers to reconstruct a hierarchy among prophets.
changed_reading.after: The comparison warns that real differentiation is known and enacted by the Lord, while human projections of divine preference remain suspect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated heavens-and-earth frame is populated in context by universal praise that humans cannot comprehend. The focus's بِمَن consequently reads less like a static census and more like knowledge of active, partly inaudible responders; prophetic differentiation occurs inside that larger field of creaturely address.

activation_trace.role: Full disclosure to the knower supplies access to modes of response hidden from human listeners.
The upper shelter repeats the spatial field that context fills with praise.
The lower pole completes the same praise-filled totality.
Worshipful praise turns the cosmic inventory into an active field of address.
Praise opposed to blame gives the universal activity its evaluative direction.
Failed comprehension establishes the human epistemic limit that the focus's superior knowing exceeds.

structural_cues: 17:44 places universal praise beside explicit human non-comprehension before 17:55 repeats superior knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic praise and human failure to understand it; I infer that knowing 'whoever' includes knowing each being's unread mode of response. The narrower alternative is a simple claim about who occupies each realm.

changed_reading.before: God knows the occupants of two spatial domains.
changed_reading.after: God knows a cosmos of active responders whose praise exceeds human comprehension, and prophetic distinctions sit within that universal responsiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contextual superlative knowing penetrates how people listen, their private counsel, and their deceptive label for the messenger. This makes the focus's knowledge claim adjudicative: divine differentiation sees mission and reception beneath public reputation, where hearers can mistake a God-reporting prophet for a manipulated man.

activation_trace.role: Non-conjectural knowing anchors the authority to distinguish prophetic stations.
The divine-reporting office supplies what hostile reception fails to recognize.
Auditory reception supplies the observable act whose hidden quality divine knowledge penetrates.
Secret counsel supplies the concealed social process that manufactures a public judgment.
Diversion and deception expose the hostile label as a distortion of prophetic agency.

structural_cues: 17:47 repeats أَعْلَمُ and immediately specifies concealed listening and whispering.
The context contrasts a prophetic addressee with the hearers' reductive label 'a man bewitched.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden reception and mislabeling; I infer that the focus's superior knowing corrects reputation-based rankings. Alternatively, the two knowledge clauses may share wording without making reception the criterion of favor.

changed_reading.before: Prophetic standing can be inferred from visible acclaim or rejection.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's differentiation cuts beneath reputation because human listening, whispering, and labeling can invert the reality of a prophetic mission.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the favored prophet and his gift, invoked beings are denied ownership of harm-removal, then shown seeking means and nearness to their own Lord while hoping and fearing. The sequence contains prophetic favor inside servanthood: differentiated recipients can be close and gifted without possessing autonomous divine agency.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship keeps every differentiated recipient within one governing relation.
Received bestowal marks David as recipient rather than autonomous source.
Denied ownership removes independent disposal from the beings people invoke.
Lifting a covering supplies the concrete relief those invoked beings cannot control.
Active seeking places the invoked beings on the dependent side of the relation.
The favored intimacy of those nearest supplies closeness without transferring kingship.
Hoped-for mercy keeps the near ones dependent on divine tenderness.
Anticipatory fear completes their posture of accountable dependence.

structural_cues: 17:55 is bracketed by 17:54's denial that the messenger is a custodian over people and 17:56's denial that invoked beings own relief.
17:57 returns twice to the Lord and depicts the invoked beings as seekers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a favored recipient between explicit limits on delegated agency; I infer that the sequence blocks deification of differentiated prophets. The alternative is that the post-focus warning concerns other invoked beings without specifying prophets.

changed_reading.before: Greater favor could imply a share in autonomous divine power.
changed_reading.after: Favor names differentiated nearness and commission within servanthood; even the nearest remain seeking, hoping, fearing recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: Four ayat later the identical bestowal formula introduces a visible sign that is rejected, and the next ayah names revelatory display as a trial. That recurrence makes gift a high-stakes exposure as well as honor: what is given can disclose recipients and audiences by the response it elicits.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal supplies the shared delivery mechanism linking the Zabur to the later sign.
Written form gives the focus gift a public, receivable body.
The repeated act of giving supplies the direct formal bridge from prophetic book to communal sign.
A manifest mark makes divine giving evidentiary rather than merely honorific.
Visible perception stresses that even a disclosed sign can be mishandled.
Assaying metal or persons supplies the diagnostic function of revelatory display.

structural_cues: 17:55 and 17:59 repeat وَآتَيْنَا with a named recipient and a concrete object.
The later sequence moves from visible sign and wrongdoing to a revelatory trial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated bestowal, a manifest sign, rejection, and testing; I infer an analogous exposing function for the Zabur. A live alternative is that David's gift marks his station while the later sign tests a community in a categorically different way.

changed_reading.before: The Zabur is a reward that simply confirms David's elevated status.
changed_reading.after: The Zabur can also be an entrusted, public sign whose reception exposes and differentiates those who encounter it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby declaration that an outcome stands in a book as aligned writing activates the Zabur's inscription branch. Joining signs into text and fixing an obligatory determination give written form operative durability; David's gift can carry a commission through time rather than function as a decorative badge.

activation_trace.role: Book-writing anchors the model directly in the named focus gift.
Joining element to element supplies the constructive assembly of a durable text.
An inscription that fixes judgment supplies operative force beyond mere notation.
Ordered written lines make the contextual record materially explicit.

structural_cues: The first post-focus book vocabulary occurs in 17:58 as الْكِتَابِ مَسْطُورًا.
The focus names a book immediately after describing differentiated prophetic gifts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a written Zabur and a nearby written determination; I infer that inscription is a durable vehicle of commission. The alternative is that the later book records destiny and says nothing about the Zabur's practical force.

changed_reading.before: Zabur is only the title of the object David received.
changed_reading.after: Its written form is part of the favor: inscription stabilizes a prophetic commission and lets it remain operative beyond the immediate recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context first fills heavens and earth with praise, then depicts a call answered with praise. The focus moves from that same cosmic span to one prophet's written gift. This sequence activates the Zabur as a localized, textual articulation within a universal response rather than an isolated possession.

activation_trace.role: The upper cosmic domain carries forward the setting already filled with praise.
The lower cosmic domain completes the universal field in which the textual voice is placed.
Written book-form localizes an otherwise universal response in a durable prophetic medium.
Universal worshipful praise supplies the larger chorus within which a differentiated text can sound.
Praise gives the cosmic activity a shared orientation.
Praise in the call-and-response scene supplies a temporal model of answer, not only static acclaim.

structural_cues: 17:44 supplies universal praise across the same heavens-and-earth pair repeated in 17:55.
17:52 places praise inside a call-and-response construction three ayat before the Zabur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic praise, an answered call with praise, and a written gift; I supply the arrow that the gift textualizes one differentiated response. The live alternative is that the Zabur is cited only as evidence of rank, with no praise-function implied here.

changed_reading.before: David's book is an isolated token distinguishing him from other prophets.
changed_reading.after: David's book can be heard as one durable, differentiated textual voice within the praise of the whole cosmos.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant branch of ن ب ء and combines it with the context's route-seeking language. It remains anchored in the focus's prophet root and in repeated contextual paths; downstream prose should present it only as a branch image, not as an etymological replacement for prophet or a claim that all routes are equivalent.

activation_trace.role: A clear road to a destination recasts prophetic plurality as differentiated guidance-functions.
Seeking supplies the directed movement that makes a route functionally relevant.
A traversable extended path supplies the spatial mechanism of approach.
Loss of a traversable path shows that distorted comparison can disable orientation.
Nearness supplies the destination toward which the differentiated routes are imagined to conduct.

changed_reading.before: The prophets are comparable occupants of fixed rank positions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their differentiation can be pictured as distinct clear routes that conduct seekers toward nearness, with misdrawn comparisons causing loss of way.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the focus root's stone-lined-well branch and water-channel branch to nearby stone, iron, and inscription imagery. The exact focus roots and context materials keep it anchored, but downstream prose must label it a material analogy for containment and durability, not a lexical definition of Zabur or a claim about the substance of David's book.

activation_trace.role: Lining a well with stone supplies a durable receptacle that prevents what it holds from dispersing.
A directed watercourse supplies the channel by which the received content reaches and fills its receptacle.
Hard stone supplies the nearby material image of resistance and durable boundary.
Iron-like solidity intensifies the contextual image of a form that resists dissolution.
Joining parts into a whole converts material containment into an analogy for textual construction.

changed_reading.before: The gift is unexamined content carried by a book-title.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, revelation is channeled into a lined, durable textual receptacle that holds its commission against dispersal.

strongest_changes: Divine preference is an authorized, relational allotment under one Lord, not a hierarchy reconstructed from human prestige.
The heavens-and-earth frame becomes a field of hidden praise, so superior knowing concerns active responses that humans cannot fully comprehend.
David's Zabur shifts from prestige token to received textual commission, public sign, and durable operative record.
The post-focus denial of autonomous ownership contains even the most favored recipients within seeking, hoping, fearing servanthood.
The repeated bestowal formula makes a gift capable of testing and exposing its audience as well as honoring its recipient.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly made differentiation functional rather than merely scalar: hidden listening, cosmic praise, dependent nearness, visible testing, and written durability all changed what prophetic favor does. The most generative surprise was that a particular book can localize a universal response without removing its recipient from servanthood.
remaining_uncertainties: The marking activation from the split س م و inventory is useful but form-distant.
The testing function of the later bestowed sign may not transfer fully to David's Zabur.
The textual-voice model depends on a sequence-level inference rather than an explicit statement about the Zabur's contents.
The route and lined-receptacle readings should remain exploratory material analogies.
